subject: Matemática
description_pt: Reconhecer volume como grandeza associada a sólidos geométricos e medir volumes por meio de empilhamento de cubos, utilizando, preferencialmente, objetos concretos.

components.description_pt: Reconhecer volume como atributo de figuras sólidas
components.description_en: Recognize volume as an attribute of solid figures
components.cc_component_description: Recognize volume as an attribute of solid figures

components.description_pt: Encontrar o volume de uma figura tridimensional contando cubos unitários
components.description_en: Find the volume of a three-dimensional figure by counting unit cubes
components.cc_component_description: Find the volume of a three-dimensional figure by counting unit cubes

components.description_pt: Comparar volumes de sólidos diferentes usando empilhamento de cubos unitários
components.description_en: Compare volumes of different solids using unit cube stacking
components.cc_component_description: Know that a solid figure which can be packed without gaps or overlaps using "n" unit cubes is said to have a volume of "n" cubic units

cc_matches.description: Measure volumes by counting unit cubes, using cubic cm, cubic in, cubic ft, and improvised units.
Recognize volume as an attribute of solid figures and understand concepts of volume measurement.
A solid figure which can be packed without gaps or overlaps using n unit cubes is said to have a volume of n cubic units.

prerequisites.description_pt: Comparar, visualmente ou por superposição, áreas de faces de objetos, de figuras planas ou de desenhos.

unlocks.description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas de cálculo de medida do volume de blocos retangulares, envolvendo as unidades usuais (metro cúbico, decímetro cúbico e centímetro cúbico).
